title: Filter scoped order profit evidence by customer and original currency
description: A user narrows the dynamic order-profit evidence report by optional CustomerId and original Currency. Validate positive customer identifiers and only supported Currency enum codes (CNY/USD/EUR/HKD/GBP/JPY), normalizing absent values compatibly and rejecting numeric/unknown codes. Intersect the customer filter with current user scope in the SalesOrders EF source query before the existing 501-header cap probe and before page slicing, never filter an already bounded result. Preserve the mandatory scope parameter and existing callers through compatible optional arguments/overload. Keep existing 366-day/500-order/10000-detail caps and explicit overflow errors. Designer sends current filters consistently for preview/detail Excel/detail PDF and displays server-normalized filter context; out-of-scope identifiers produce no names/rows/amounts. Reset page when filters change; retain fields/date/page-size on errors and present safe empty/denied/invalid/network states. Original-currency/unknown-cost semantics remain unchanged; add no lookup endpoint or new menu. Development only: reuse existing order-profit menu, fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService, approved nondeleted scoped SalesOrders and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Do not accept client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority or widen ERP permissions. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible actions, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated work. Run focused in-memory API/service/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any unavailable external environment acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Validated optional customer/original-currency filters intersect current ERP scope in the source query before cap probes and pagination; omitted filters retain existing behavior and no source-free scope bypass is added.
Preview/Excel/PDF and designer retain the same normalized filters and show filter/date/page/currency/unknown-basis context, with page reset on filter changes and no unauthorized name leakage.

Focused tests cover scope intersection/revocation, supported/unknown currency codes, invalid IDs, filtering before 500-order limit and legacy API/service/export behavior; safe Release build/test passes.
